content: Now I'll rewrite the OTP page with all the enhancements — animated circular countdown, auto-submit on fill, retry, and improved resend flow:

args.Description: "Complete rewrite of the OTP page with: animated SVG circular countdown ring (turns red when ≤10s), auto-submit when all 6 digits are filled, Clear & Retry button, and an improved Send OTP Again button that appears after countdown expires with loading state."
